newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka November avg inflation at 15.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka November avg inflation at 15.5 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's annual average inflation last month rose to 15.5 percent from 15.3 percent the previous month, the Department of Census and Statistics said on Monday.
The Colombo Consumer Price Index for November rose to 2004.7 from 1982.7 in October, an increase of 22.0 index points or 1.1 percent, it said.
The rise was mainly due to increases in the prices of bread, tea, milk, sugar, eggs, coconuts, and some vegetables, it said in a statement.
